HOENN is full of rare discoveries.
You can find them at your own pace.\pMany legendaries are wild residents
with a 3% encounter chance each.\lRoute signs list them and mark\leach one you catch.\pSWEET SCENT helps find them.\pOther wild discoveries need local
help, story progress or partners.\lThose have 1% chances normally.\lSWEET SCENT gives a shared 25%\lchance among eligible, uncaught\llocal legends.\pRead the area signs for the exact
requirements. Failed encounters\lremain available until caught.\pOthers await you at special places
or come from rewards. Talk to the\lpeople you meet on your travels.$
